title: Polite Irony, Conversational Warmth, and Essayistic Distance

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Antal Szerb mastered the art of wearing monumental erudition (*erudíció*) with effortless lightness (*könnyedség*). His prose employs delicate conversational understatement, gentle self-irony (*önirónia*), and witty parentheticals: *ahogy a kedves olvasó bizonyára sejti*.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Stylistic politeness in C1 literary essays softens dogmatic assertions: modal conditionals (*megkockáztathatjuk azt a feltevést*, *aligha tévedünk, ha úgy véljük*) invite the reader into a collegial conspiracy of cultivated minds.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A tudós erudíció és a szellemes könnyedség ötvözete...
The synthesis of scholarly erudition and witty lightness...
We may venture the assumption that...
He observes the world with subtle self-irony...
